name: @wellsfargo-starui/core
description: MarketsUI core runtime â€” vanilla-TS grid engine, host ports (browser adapter + Dexie config store), and widget framework. Consolidates engine, host, host-browser, host-config, widget, widget-browser.

scripts.build: rimraf engine/dist engine/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo host/dist host/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo host-browser/dist host-browser/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo host-config/dist host-config/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo widget/dist widget/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo widget-browser/dist widget-browser/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && (cd engine && tsc && vite build && cd ..) && tsc --project host/tsconfig.json && tsc --project host-browser/tsconfig.json && tsc --project host-config/tsconfig.json && node host-config/scripts/copy-assets.mjs && tsc --project widget/tsconfig.json && tsc --project widget-browser/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project host/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project host-browser/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project host-config/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project widget/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project widget-browser/tsconfig.json
